description: Upload a token picture (PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF; min 64x64; max 2 MB; SVG/HTML rejected). Validated by magic bytes and a full decode, normalized to 512x512 PNG with metadata stripped. Returns imageId + imageUrl to pass to build_launch_tx. Free.

imageBase64.description: raw base64 or a data: URI

imageUrl.description: https:// or ipfs:// link (we fetch it, private addresses blocked)

name: upload_token_image
